transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I guess what brings me here is that my talking gets all mixed up. I try to explain things to people... like about the keys, and then I start talking about the jail, then the prayer rug, and then the chess pieces. Folks tell me they just cannot follow what I am saying.
About how long have you been having this trouble with your thoughts and speech?

Well, it's been going on for... I'd say about two years and five months now. It started right after I had this brief detention. There was a misunderstanding at the building where I clean, and, well, ever since then, my words just haven't been coming out right.
Do you ever hear voices or sounds that other people around you cannot hear?

Yeah, I do. Sometimes... well, I'll hear a man's voice. It usually comes from the air vents, or from inside the mop closet when I'm cleaning. He says my name, or he just keeps telling me that I ruined everything. And it's not like a thought in my head, it sounds... it sounds just as real as if someone was standing right beside me. But there's never anybody else around.
During these past couple of years, have you had periods where you felt severely depressed, down, or hopeless?
Yes, I have. On my bad days... I just sit on the edge of the bed after morning prayer. I feel so heavy and... empty. It just feels like there is no point in cleaning myself up or even going outside.
Have you heard the voices or had trouble with your thoughts during times when you were not feeling down or depressed?

Yeah, I have. There have been... well, calmer weeks. Times when I wasn't feeling especially high, and I wasn't deeply depressed either. Just kind of even. But even during those times, for more than two weeks straight, I still heard that man in the vents. And I still believed the people working in the building were... you know, making signals about me. So it doesn't just happen when I'm feeling down.
Looking back over the past two and a half years, would you say these depressed periods have been going on for most of that time, or only for a small part of it?

Well, if I look back over the whole two and a half years... it hasn't been most of the time. If I had to add it all up, I'd say those heavy, hopeless periods have amounted to about seven months total since this all started. So it's just a part of it, not the whole time.
